title: Local user URIs are exactly mimi://<provider>/u/<id> (protocol-07 §2.1)
description: Assay of draft-mahy-mimi-identity-05 (~/PROJECT/IETF/specs, sha256 c95f8c88a7be37c298db977250e5fbf1dfb6894e0a779ae7032940af8778381a). LocalUser::authenticated (crates/mimid-server/src/follower/relay.rs:80-88) and Store::create_account (crates/mimid-server/src/store/jmap.rs:140) accept any URI whose authority is this provider, including the provider URI itself (mimi://a.example, which is the hub's own BasicCredential identity per decision mimid-1wgh.6.35) and room (/r/) or client (/d/) URIs. identity-05 L407-408: 'The first path segment in a MIMI URI discriminates the type of identifier and makes the type of resource unambiguous' (Table 3, L410-429: /u/ user, /d/ client, /r/ room, /g/ MLS group, /p/ pseudonym, /t/ team). protocol-06 shows the same forms only as examples (§3 Table 1, L317-345; not normative), so this is hardening, not conformance. Decide (Mark): require exactly mimi://<provider>/u/<one segment> for local users (accounts, KeyPackage credential identities, relay identity checks), refusing the provider URI so no user can share the hub's identity. If yes: regression test first (a user URI equal to the hub identity and one with /r/ are refused), decision bead, wg item below.
design: protocol-07 §2.1 (Table 1, PR #177) makes the first path segment of a MIMI URI the identifier type: a user URI is mimi://<provider>/u/<id>; a provider URI has no path. It does not say what <id> may contain. Readings: (a) any non-empty remainder after /u/, including further '/'; (b) one non-empty path segment. Chosen: (b), with no query or fragment (RFC 3986 path segments exclude '?' and '#'). The spec's examples are single segments, and failing closed keeps a user from colliding with another identifier type or with the hub's own identity mimi://<provider> (decision mimid-1wgh.6.35). Applied to local users at LocalUser::authenticated (so JMAP bearer auth and KeyPackage upload) and Store::create_account, via hub::user_uri_domain. Remote users' URIs are still checked for domain only.
close_reason: hub::user_uri_domain (protocol-07 §2.1; this decision) used by LocalUser::authenticated and Store::create_account. Tests local_user_uri_must_be_a_user_uri and create_account_refuses_non_user_uris failed first on mimi://a.example being accepted. No fixtures changed. Workspace tests pass in worktree.
